verdict.rationale: Mercury's own site states it in nearly the story's exact words: users can 'find any transaction, vendor, or card, or jump straight to creating payments, transfers, and more — all from one universal search bar.' The claim covers every element of the story, but it rests on a single marketing line. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of universal search behavior (scope, filters, payment hand-off), independent or hands-on corroboration that search works as described.
